# PROFILE-KEY-SPLIT baseline — generated by
# tool/check_profile_path_keying.dart --update-baseline.
# Every collection listed here has a VERIFIED, already-reviewed reason that
# the conservative checker reports both a deployed functions/src/** touch and
# a live ULID repository. bookmarks and learning_order are genuine historical
# Drift-int vs Firestore-ULID splits. The other entries use the profile ULID
# in Cloud Functions too; they are baselined because the checker treats every
# deployed functions/src/** touch as INT-B. See firestore.rules and
# functions/src/tutor_writes.ts for the shared profile path construction.
# track_learning_order joined with Story 1.10 (DNI-472): the shared
# functions/src/write_with_change_log.ts helper addresses it under
# learner_profiles/{profileId ULID}, the same tree the Firestore repository
# reads — not a genuine split.
# learning_events, sub_tracks and change_log joined with Story 1.2 (DNI-464):
# FirestoreLearningEventRepository / FirestoreSubTrackRepository read
# users/{uid}/learner_profiles/{profileId ULID}/..., and writeWithChangeLog
# (functions/src/write_with_change_log.ts) and the tutor learning callables
# (functions/src/tutor_learning.ts) address the same profileRef
# users/{ownerUid}/learner_profiles/{profileId ULID} — not a genuine split.
# points_ledger and point_configs joined with Story 1.7 (DNI-469): the
# owner LearningCommands write port (FirestoreLearningEventRepository
# .commit) co-writes points_ledger/pts_{eventId} and
# FirestorePointsAmountReader reads point_configs under
# users/{uid}/learner_profiles/{profileId ULID}/..., the same profileRef
# writeWithChangeLog's AD-50 pts_ attach uses — not a genuine split.
# A new collection NOT listed here fails `make audit`/`make ci`.
# Widening this file requires the same team sign-off any other ratchet
# widening requires — a new entry here means a NEW collection became
# genuinely production-split, not that this checker got noisier.
